label: Sonos Era 300 spatial-audio smart speaker
description: Sonos Era 300 is a six-driver spatial-audio speaker with Dolby Atmos support, Sonos voice control, AirPlay 2 and Bluetooth 5.3. Networking is Wi-Fi only: Wi-Fi 6 on 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax at 2.4 and 5 GHz; the speaker has no RJ45 jack, and Ethernet is reachable only through the sold-separately Sonos USB-C Combo Adapter, so treat it as a wireless client.
